primaryTextRead.text: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.

wikipediaRead.title: Keturah
wikipediaRead.locator: The current Zimran URL redirects to Keturah. L148 records that redirect, L157 lists Zimran as a son, L188 names him among Keturah’s six sons, and L192 begins a dedicated Zimran subsection.
wikipediaRead.supportParaphraseJa: 英語版記事は、ジムランをアブラハムとケトラの子として挙げています。
wikipediaRead.identityAssessmentJa: The Keturah page’s children list and Zimran subsection directly support the name and parentage in 1 Chronicles 1:32.
